violations.text: Queso Fresco from a residential source (per owner) was observed being sold in establishment. Food was voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Food to only be purchased from a licensed facility. Approved Source guidance document provided during time of inspection. https://datahealth.ri.gov/publications/guidance/FoodProtectionApprovedSource.pdf Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026

Commercially processed chicharrones and rosca packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients and sub ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

Wood is used in the construction of retail shelving. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2026

Hose observed attached to bottom of handsink. This faucet is lacking a backflow prevention device. An approved backflow prevention device is required in order to prevent backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply at each point of use at a food establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2026

The door to the outside--located in the rear and the bulkhead door leading to the basement, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026

The ceiling in the meat cutting area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable (acoustic composite tiles). Materials for ceiling surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, and ware-washing areas. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional clutter, equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026
